# Parkinson's disease — frontier platforms

## Concept packs

- [Run-level pack: Frontier platforms](https://llmsx.org/tree/parkinson-s-disease-frontier-platforms-cell-replacement-gene-therapy-digital-biomarkers-ai-gut-brain-axis-and-precision-medicine/): Run-level pack covering dopaminergic cell replacement, gene therapy, digital biomarkers and wearables, AI, the gut-brain axis
- [AI and machine learning in PD diagnosis and progression](https://llmsx.org/tree/ai-and-machine-learning-in-pd-diagnosis-and-progression/): Systematic reviews of machine learning in Parkinson's disease report a translation gap
- [Digital biomarkers: wearables and remote monitoring in PD](https://llmsx.org/tree/digital-biomarkers-wearables-and-remote-monitoring-in-pd/): Reviews report that most included studies were cross-sectional and call for standardization
- [Dopaminergic cell replacement: bemdaneprocel and iPSC-derived neurons](https://llmsx.org/tree/dopaminergic-cell-replacement-bemdaneprocel-and-ipsc-derived-neurons/): Cell replacement for Parkinson's disease transplants dopaminergic progenitor cells derived from embryonic or induced pluripotent stem cells
- [Gene therapy in PD: AAV-GDNF/AADC/GAD and GBA1 vectors](https://llmsx.org/tree/gene-therapy-in-pd-aav-gdnf-aadc-gad-and-gba1-vectors/): A regulator announcement about AADC deficiency concerns a different indication
- [Gut-brain axis: microbiome and body-first versus brain-first PD](https://llmsx.org/tree/gut-brain-axis-microbiome-and-body-first-versus-brain-first-pd/): Two randomized fecal microbiota transplantation trials report different primary-outcome results
- [PD subtypes and precision medicine](https://llmsx.org/tree/pd-subtypes-and-precision-medicine/): Studies in different cohorts report that Parkinson's disease subtypes differ in progression, and authors link the failure of disease-modifying trials in part to heterogeneity

## Top sources, live-checked 2026-11-27

- [nature.com/articles/s41586-025-08845-y (6 claims in this run)](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-08845-y): The authors report that at 18 months after grafting putaminal 18Fluoro-DOPA positron emission tomography uptake increased, which they interpret as indicating graft survival
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11657025 (4 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11657025/): Data leakage inflates reported accuracy in PD machine learning: the neuroimaging review reports that data leakage was associated with a significant inflation of accuracies
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10108794 (3 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10108794/): In WATCH-PD, the authors report that device-derived features, particularly arm swing, the proportion of time with tremor
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11112052 (3 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11112052/): Systematic reviews of machine learning in PD report a translation gap
- [pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32830221 (3 claims in this run)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32830221/): The authors of the original case-control study hypothesize that isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder (iRBD) is a prodromal phenotype for the body-first type
- [clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT06285643 (2 claims in this run)](https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT06285643): REGENERATE-PD (NCT06285643) is registered as a phase 2 randomized, double-blind, sham surgery-controlled study of intraputaminal AAV2-GDNF in adults with moderate stage Parkinson's disease
- [clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT06944522 (2 claims in this run)](https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT06944522): The registry record lists exPDite-2 as RECRUITING with an estimated primary completion date of 2028-10
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11925012 (2 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11925012/): Reports differ on motor progression in SAA-negative Parkinson's disease: an analysis of LRRK2 carriers reports less severe motor manifestations and decline without alpha-synuclein aggregates
